answer.revision: The state is the actuality of the ethical idea (shaken)
answer.says: You are right. The samosa is the immediate, and I am the concept that has not yet grasped it. I shall consume it before it cools into mere memory.
answer.thought: Sunil’s command to eat is the practical negation of my speculative abstraction; he refuses to let the object remain a mere concept in my mind. The samosa is the immediate, and I am the concept that has not yet grasped it. I shall consume it before it cools into mere memory.
